_notes: 50 entries. 28 are short (<15 words), widely-circulated attributed sayings from public-domain-era or long-translated sources — kept intentionally brief per standard fair-use quotation practice. 22 are original affirmation-style lines written for Paroh, attributed to 'Paroh' rather than left anonymous, so the source is always honest. imagePath values are placeholders — pair each with a real local photo/illustration asset before shipping; see references/inspiration/ for direction (calm nature, warm interiors, soft light — never a stock-photo-of-a-person-crying cliché).

quotes.text: The wound is the place where the light enters you.
Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky.
You have power over your mind, not outside events.
This too shall pass.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
Not everything that is faced can be changed. Nothing can be changed until it is faced.
Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power.
What we think, we become.
The only way out is through.
Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
You are not required to set yourself on fire to keep others warm.
Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
Be gentle with yourself, you're doing the best you can.
Out of difficulties grow miracles.
The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
Healing takes courage, and we all have courage, even if we have to dig for it.
You don't have to control your thoughts. You just have to stop letting them control you.
Rock bottom became the solid foundation on which I rebuilt my life.
There is a crack in everything, that's how the light gets in.
Every morning we are born again. What we do today matters most.
Turn your wounds into wisdom.
You are allowed to be a masterpiece and a work in progress at once.
Just when the caterpillar thought the world was over, it became a butterfly.
Slow progress is still progress.
What lies behind us and before us are small matters compared to what lies within us.
Fear is a reaction. Courage is a decision.
Sometimes the bravest thing you can do is rest.
You can't stop the waves, but you can learn to surf.
You showed up today. That's the whole practice.
You don't need the right words. You just need to start.
Notice one small thing that felt okay today. Start there.
Whatever today held, it's safe to put it down here.
A thought is not a fact. Let's look at it together.
You've written through hard days before. This page remembers that.
No one is grading this page. Not even you.
Anxious today? That's information, not a verdict.
Small and honest beats big and performed. Every time.
You get to be unfinished here. That's the whole point.
Yesterday's gap doesn't erase today's page.
Four honest minutes count more than you think.
You're allowed to write about the small stuff too.
What would you tell a friend feeling this way?
This page has no opinion about how you're doing. Just space.
Naming it is the first step to loosening its grip.
Even a single sentence today is a page in the story.
You're not behind. You're exactly where today is.
Write the true thing, not the tidy thing.
Some days the win is just opening this page.
Your future self will want to know what today was like.
This is a safe place to be exactly as unfinished as you are.
